item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 17/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days, temperatures over the region will rise progressively. The weather will be rather warm during the day on Saturday. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China between Saturday night and Sunday morning. The associated intense winter monsoon will affect the region in the following few days. It will become cold appreciably. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will also bring rainy weather to the region.
